description: Convert a number of minutes into hours and minutes, or convert hours (plus optional extra minutes) into total minutes. Set mode to 'minutesToHours' or 'hoursToMinutes'. Returns a clock-style breakdown and decimal hours. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/minutes-to-hours/

extraMinutes.description: Extra minutes to add to the hours (used when mode is 'hoursToMinutes', default 0)

hours.description: Hours to convert (used when mode is 'hoursToMinutes', 0 to 100000)

minutes.description: Minutes to convert (used when mode is 'minutesToHours', 0 to 10000000)

name: hopi_minutes_to_hours

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Minutes to hours converter
